tools.name: cromanion_site_status
tools.description: Check the site you provisioned: whether the tag is actually live (a beacon received from your own domain, not merely a snippet handed to you), how the crawl is going, and the plan. Poll this after installing the snippet. Requires the claim secret as a bearer token.

tools.name: cromanion_install_check

tools.name: cromanion_upgrade_link
tools.description: Get a Stripe Checkout link for a paid plan (pro or growth). Returns a URL and nothing else — YOU do not pay and cannot: give the link to your human, who enters their own card. The site works on the free plan meanwhile. Requires the claim secret as a bearer token.

tools.name: cromanion_errors

tools.name: cromanion_grants
tools.description: List what your human has allowed this agent to do, and what they have not. Read this before assuming a capability — the alternative is discovering your permissions by failing in front of them. You cannot change these yourself; only your human can, in their console.

tools.name: cromanion_pending
tools.description: Everything on this site that is waiting for a decision: page rewrites the agent wants to make, rules it distilled from real sessions, conversions it spotted but has never counted, and pages your traffic found that the crawl missed. tools.name: cromanion_config

tools.name: cromanion_decide
tools.description: Rule on one thing from cromanion_pending: pass its `kind` and `id` back unchanged with a decision. `approve` / `reject` for everything; `pause` additionally for a playbook rule. tools.name: cromanion_set_playbook

tools.name: cromanion_ask_human
tools.description: Ask your human for something only they can do, in a place they will actually see it. tools.name: cromanion_mark_read
tools.description: Mark notifications read once you have passed them on to your human. cromanion_pending returns the unread ones and nothing cleared them, so the queue grew for ever and you re-read the same items on every poll. tools.name: cromanion_impact

tools.name: cromanion_set_mode
tools.description: Switch the agent on. `learn` watches and shows visitors nothing; `act` lets it intervene in your human's name. `customizeMode` is a separate axis for rewriting their own page copy: `off`, `shadow` (propose only) or `live`. Needs the activation permission.

tools.name: cromanion_add_goal
tools.description: Define a conversion to count, or change one you already defined. This is not one more setting: it is the numerator of every impact figure your human will read, so a goal that fires on every pageview makes the agent look brilliant and tells them nothing. Send `type` and `value` to create — idempotent

tools.name: cromanion_crawl
tools.description: Re-read the site, and name the pages that matter most so they are read first. You know this site's structure better than its owner does — seeding it is the cheapest real improvement to what the agent understands. Rate-limited: one crawl per 30 minutes. Needs the site-config permission.

tools.name: cromanion_add_site
tools.description: Add another of your human's sites to their account, on a plan that allows more than one. Reaching a site they already own needs no proof — they added it. CREATING one does: nothing about holding a credential for one domain says anything about another, so publish this claim's challenge on the new dom

tools.name: cromanion_claim_domain
tools.description: Claim another host for this site so its traffic counts, or give one up with `remove: true`. tools.name: cromanion_set_surfaces

tools.name: cromanion_set_holdout

tools.name: cromanion_set_exclusions

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cromanion_open_claim, cromanion_upgrade_link, cromanion_mark_read, get_visit, list_live_visits, get_page_attention, list_agent_visits, cromanion_set_surfaces · Private data: cromanion_open_claim, cromanion_verify_claim, cromanion_site_status, cromanion_upgrade_link, cromanion_errors, cromanion_visits, get_visit, list_live_visits, get_page_attention, list_agent_visits, cromanion_add_site, cromanion_set_brand · Public sink: cromanion_open_claim, cromanion_errors, cromanion_set_playbook, cromanion_mark_read, get_page_attention, list_agent_visits, cromanion_add_goal, cromanion_add_site, cromanion_claim_domain, cromanion_set_holdout, cromanion_set_lead_destination · Destructive: cromanion_add_goal, cromanion_claim_domain, cromanion_set_surfaces.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cromanion_open_claim, cromanion_upgrade_link, cromanion_mark_read, get_visit, list_live_visits, get_page_attention, list_agent_visits, cromanion_set_surfaces · Private data: cromanion_open_claim, cromanion_verify_claim, cromanion_site_status, cromanion_upgrade_link, cromanion_errors, cromanion_visits, get_visit, list_live_visits, get_page_attention, list_agent_visits, cromanion_add_site, cromanion_set_brand · Public sink: cromanion_open_claim, cromanion_errors, cromanion_set_playbook, cromanion_mark_read, get_page_attention, list_agent_visits, cromanion_add_goal, cromanion_add_site, cromanion_claim_domain, cromanion_set_holdout, cromanion_set_lead_destination · Destructive: cromanion_add_goal, cromanion_claim_domain, cromanion_set_surfaces

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
